name: Business Academy Aarhus
about: Business Academy Aarhus is a business academy (erhvervsakademi) in Viby, on the south side of Aarhus. Its one English-taught first degree is Multimedia Design, a two-year AP degree in web and interface design, front-end programming and AI tools, which ends with a ten-week internship. It is shorter than a bachelor's, and the academy's own Digital Concept Development top-up turns it into one in a further 18 months.

languageOfInstruction.note: Multimedia Design is the only English-taught programme that takes students straight from upper secondary school. Digital Concept Development is an English top-up that needs an AP degree first.

notes: Business Academy Aarhus takes a stricter view of the English requirement than its subject list suggests. The specific requirement is English C, but the language requirement is English B, which only an accepted test can replace.
